node.statement: Quantitative graph construction: if additionally c=64*(epsilon_r+delta)<=1/8, then for every P in B^{icalH}_{2delta}(0) there is a unique g_V(P) in B^{calH}_{2delta}(0) with F(P,g_V(P))=0. These values form a C^1 map and satisfy ||g_V(P)+q/2||<=64*(epsilon_r*delta+delta^2), ||Dg_V(P)||<=128*(epsilon_r+delta), and ||D_H F(P,g_V(P))-I_calH||<=64*(epsilon_r+delta)<1.
